```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_means = df[spending_cols].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
labels = [col.replace('Mnt', '') for col in spending_means.index]

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.bar(labels, spending_means.values)
plt.title('Average Monthly Spending by Product Category')
plt.ylabel('Average Spending (€)')
plt.xlabel('Product Category')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout
